title: Latent Earns a 94.5 in the 2026 KLAS Emerging Company Spotlight
summary: KLAS scored Latent Health 94.5 overall, with A+ ratings for likelihood to recommend, partnership, and would buy again, in the first KLAS Spotlight report on enterprise pharmacy intelligence.
body_markdown:
KLAS Research published its first Emerging Company Spotlight on enterprise pharmacy intelligence. KLAS scored Latent Health 94.5 overall, against a best in KLAS software average of 81.1, with A+ ratings for likelihood to recommend, partnership, and would buy again.*


Every score comes from independent KLAS interviews with customers, including some of the largest health systems in the country.


[Read the report →](https://latenthealth.com/klas-emerging-technology-2026)


*Limited data.
